generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a thicket of tall, upright to arching, golden-brown stems with leaves of three toothed leaflets and single magenta flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 2.2 m tall at 12 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: bright green leaflets; magenta flowers; shredding golden-brown bark. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: the last salmonberries, raspberry-like, yellow-orange to red, about 2 cm long. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: magenta flowers in March to May; berries yellow-orange to red in late May into July. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate.
